The parser reads a complete calculation log without raising an exception, and the returned coordinates and ordinary metadata look plausible. However, for calculations that include an optional long-range pairwise energy contribution, the value treated as the final molecular energy does not represent the terminal single-point result printed by the quantum-chemistry program.
